title: Sword Of Nix
description: A rain-soaked 2D cyber-noir action platformer. Slash and parry through a guarded rooftop and vertical hideout, then face the Warden.

defaultCaptions.x: Sword Of Nix: breach a rain-lit city with your katana, reflect hostile fire and face the Warden in a fast side-scrolling action game.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Step into Sword Of Nix, a rain-soaked cyber-noir action platformer. Run, jump, slash and parry through the Akai gang’s rooftop and interior stronghold before the Warden encounter.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Sword Of Nix is a 2D side-scrolling action game built around a lone cyber-ninja, a katana, focused slow motion, hostile projectiles and a multi-phase Warden boss fight.
defaultCaptions.discord: Sword Of Nix: move through the rain-lit rooftops, parry the Akai gang’s fire and make it to the Warden. Keyboard controls: A/D, Space, J/X, press E for 3s Focus (10s cooldown), F and Esc.
